Public transport schedule data (routes, stops, trips and stop times in the General Transit Feed Specification) for Vilnius city municipality, Vilnius County, Lithuania. Coverage: Vilnius city municipality, Vilnius County, Lithuania. The Mobility Database lists 1 GTFS schedule feed for this provider (Vilnius city municipality, Vilnius County, Lithuania). At least one feed is marked as published by the operator itself. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source.
